label: P1, P2 - Arms
notes: The Upgrades tab bundles this set for a warrior whose Arms tree has the most talent points (ticket 803); fallback.ep-weights.json (P1 Fury) serves every other warrior.

P3_ARMS_EP_PRESET ('P3, P4 & P5 - Arms') is not transcribed: the tab bundles one set per spec, the lowest-phase one, as it does for Fury, and its assumptions line says when a run's phase is later than the set's.
data/presets/ep-weights-by-phase.json and this repo's CLI do not read this file.
